source: TriWest Healthcare Alliance Prior Authorization List
note: This list is CATEGORY-based, not code-enumerated — TriWest names broad service categories requiring authorization rather than specific CPT/HCPCS codes. Only categories with a defensible, standard HCPCS/CPT code mapping have hcpcs_prefix/cpt_range set (currently just Durable Medical Equipment -> HCPCS E-codes, the CMS-standard DME category prefix). The remaining categories are recorded for completeness/audit-trail but have no code-matching mechanism wired up, since mapping e.g. 'Spine Surgeries' or 'Pain Management' to specific CPT ranges would require a real payer-published crosswalk this document doesn't provide.
